mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) reflects improving labor market conditions, boosting investor confidence and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not decline or 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust supply-side growth, supporting economic momentum and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not rise or returns are not positive over 60 days (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signal stronger consumer demand, driving short-term equity market gains over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 does not rise or 5-day returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 indicates robust housing demand, lifting S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST does not exceed 1200 or returns are not positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A Fed funds rate exceeding 0.4% signals aggressive monetary tightening, reducing growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not exceed 0.4% or returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Combined easing in monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) and improving labor market (UNRATE decline) create dual positive signals, amplifying S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < previous month's value AND UNRATE < previous month's value
regime_hint: dual easing and labor improvement regime
failure_condition: Either FEDFUNDS does not decline or UNRATE does not decline, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation expectations regime, simultaneous rises in CPIAUCSL (inflation) and FEDFUNDS (tightening) signal conflicting policies, reducing growth prospects and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The regime is not high inflation expectations, or the proxies do not rise as expected, or returns are not negative (t-test p > 0.05).
